West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee delivered a defiant message amid a Trinamool Congress protest outside Abhishek Banerjee's residence in Kolkata. Declaring that she would remain in Kolkata, Mamata said, “Delhi will come running to Kolkata”, as tensions between the TMC and the Centre continue.
